feature_source: Previously public and verified minimal_market_forward_v1 confirmed 25-bar DOGE/BTC ex-ante snapshot. Use no news/macro/liquidation or post-issue signals.
feature_dependencies: DOGE latest volume divided by prior 24h mean
decision_formula: For horizon h: DOGE standardized return_h + BTC regime weight*BTC standardized return_h + 0.5*DOGE minus BTC 24h relative strength normalized by sqrt(24)*max(vols). h=1 or 24; normalize h=24 returns by sqrt(24); sign is direction, exactly 0 abstains.
weights_selection: A priori fixed research hypothesis; no historical accuracy search or evidence of optimality
origin_clock: Prepared original 25 closed hour bars ingested before publication, original issue registered before target; audit per-context public witness via existing minimal_market_forward.audit
evaluation: Preselected formal frozen V2 nonoverlap forecast IDs at original issue time; exact same original score / target quote; all missing/abstention retained in denominator
reports: Accuracy all valid; missing-as-wrong; balanced accuracy; up/down recall; paired McNemar descriptive only; no probability calibration
zero_signal: Explicit abstention, counted as unqualified, never removed from total denominator
limitations: This candidate is derived deterministically from publicly pre-target source contexts, not independently separately time-issued forecast rows.
Uncalibrated raw signal magnitude must never be shown as p_up, odds, or 70% likelihood.
Existing scheduled workflow only, no new trigger.
Source first release and immutable external WORM still pending.
Research candidate may underperform, gains must be observed prospectively over different regimes.
